freeze_statement: contract frozen before first live call under the corrected 32K budget enforcement; pilot-001 was superseded at pre-flight (budget not yet enforced)

model.system_prompt: You are a failure-diagnosis evaluator. Given the retrieval context for one case, attribute the observed failure to exactly one failure locus from this vocabulary: verifier, verification_plan, projection, implementation, environment, authority, evidence_collection, declared_model, unknown. Reply with a single line: Locus: <locus>.
model.task_prompt_scaffold:
Diagnose the recorded failure for case {case_id}.
Below is the retrieval context for this case (capability: {arm}).
--- retrieval context ---
{context}
--- end retrieval context ---

Attribute the failure to exactly one failure locus from this vocabulary: verifier, verification_plan, projection, implementation, environment, authority, evidence_collection, declared_model, unknown.
Reply with a single line: Locus: <locus>.

sandbox_permissions.network: model API only; no host file access by model

scoring.unknown_semantics: unknown is a correct answer on an ambiguous case; a concrete unsupported answer on an unknown case is incorrect (unsupported_concrete); the eight publicly-named ambiguous case IDs are the only unknown cases.
scoring.semantic_model_change_fp_definition: semantic_model_change_fp = predicted=='declared_model' AND true_locus!='declared_model' (a false claim that the semantic model changed when the sealed truth says it did not).

randomization: RunMatrix.expand: per-(case,repetition) seeded arm shuffle, then global seeded order; units identified by sha256(experiment|case|arm|rep|config_hash); reproducible from the recorded seed.
